summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K on October 6, 2026, attaching a press release updating progress on its €1.0 billion share buyback programme announced April 30, 2026. During the week of September 28 to October 2, 2026, ING repurchased 1,450,000 shares at an average price of €31.08 for €45,065,980. Cumulative repurchases total 30,410,805 shares at an average €28.46, or €865,577,890.49, approximately 86.56% of the maximum programme value. The programme's purpose is to reduce share capital; the buyback is executed in the open market with no advisor named. Risk-arb angle: monitor remaining weekly execution pace and completion timing, as residual buying provides modest price support.
